decisive_items: excessive calcification of elastic fiber fragments
compound heterozygous sequence variation in GGCX gene
response.rationale: R1 aligns with hallmark PXE features including flexural yellowish papules, calcified elastic fibers on biopsy, and GGCX-related factor X deficiency. R2 only explains skin sagging and loss of elasticity but lacks the distinctive papules, histopathology, and genetic findings.

rejected.why: Skin sagging and loss of elasticity are nonspecific; cutis laxa does not account for yellowish coalesced papules, calcified elastic fibers in the dermis, low factor X activity, prolonged prothrombin time, or GGCX compound heterozygous mutations.
